Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Babylonian Talmud, Berakhot 4a, within the Rabbinic Judaism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of humility, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Talmudic tradition's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
